transcription_instructions: Transcribe the long s as s. Before each article, put its heading on its own line as [[ARTICLE: heading exactly as printed]]. Mark only printed headings that begin a distinct item. Transcribe the running head and page number as printed, unmarked. If the page opens mid-item with no heading, begin with [[CONTINUED]]. If the page is blank, write only [[BLANK PAGE]]. If it is a plate or illustration, write [[ILLUSTRATION]], then any printed caption. Leave the text otherwise unchanged.
